details.descriptionEn:
Face Sunscreen Tinted SPF 50 Tinted daily sunscreen face cream with ultra-light texture to help protect skin against photoaging. Powered by an innovative Red Grape stem cell technology active and vitamins, it helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and wrinkles, providing even skin tone for a younger-looking skin.
Broad Spectrum UVA + UVB Protection / Clinically proven Antiageing + Antispot Action
Protection from Photoaging
Dermatologically Tested
Non-Comedogenic
Water and Sweat Resistant
Reforest Aegean Seas - KORRES FOR ARCHIPELAGOS INSTITUTE
We support the Archipelagos Institute of Marine Conservation in its effort to protect the Greek sea fauna and reforest the Posidonia seagrass meadows.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, DIBUTYL ADIPATE, ISOAMYL LAURATE, DIETHYLAMINO HYDROXYBENZOYL HEXYL BENZOATE, BIS-ETHYLHEXYLOXYPHENOL METHOXYPHENYL TRIAZINE, ETHYLHEXYL SALICYLATE, POTASSIUM CETYL PHOSPHATE, TRIS-BIPHENYL TRIAZINE (NANO), DIETHYLHEXYL BUTAMIDO TRIAZONE, ALCOHOL DENAT., GLYCERYL STEARATE, POLYMETHYL METHACRYLATE, ETHYLHEXYL TRIAZONE, SILICA, CETEARYL ALCOHOL, GLYCERIN, POLYAMIDE-3, VITIS VINIFERA (GRAPE) FRUIT EXTRACT*, ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL, BISABOLOL, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, CETEARYL GLUCOSIDE, DECYL GLUCOSIDE, DISODIUM PHOSPHATE, ETHYL LINOLEATE, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, GLYCINE SOJA (SOYBEAN) OIL, ISOMALT, ISOPROPYL TITANIUM TRIISOSTEARATE, LACTIC ACID, LECITHIN, LEPIDIUM SATIVUM SPROUT EXTRACT, LONICERA CAPRIFOLIUM (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, LONICERA JAPONICA (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, NIACINAMIDE, PANTHENOL, PEG-100 STEARATE, PENTAERYTHRITYL TETRA-DI-T-BUTYL HYDROXYHYDROCINNAMATE, POLYSORBATE 80, SODIUM CARBOXYMETHYL BETA-GLUCAN, SODIUM PHYTATE, SOY ISOFLAVONES, TETRAHYDRODIFERULOYLMETHANE, TOCOPHEROL, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, VITIS VINIFERA (GRAPE) FRUIT CELL EXTRACT, XANTHAN GUM, ZINGIBER OFFICINALE (GINGER) ROOT EXTRACT, CI 77491/IRON OXIDES, CI 77492/IRON OXIDES, CI 77499/IRON OXIDES, CI 77891/ TITANIUM DIOXIDE, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE, ALCOHOL. *KORRES SANTORINI GRAPE FRUIT EXTRACT
653 The Greek grape extract -part of our innovative Red Grape Stem Cell Antioxidant System- comes from the island of Santorini. Starved at the foot of the volcano, misted by the Aegean Sea, and growing into a basket-like cylinder to defend itself against the intense Greek sun and the harsh Cycladic winds, the Santorini grape is sustainably cultivated in arid volcanic-ash-rich soil. We source the marcs, the by-products of the cultivation, from the Union of Santorini Cooperatives/Santowine. It is the first time that the great volume of vinification by-products, instead of being discarded, is used to produce a cosmetic extract.
50mL / 1.69 FL. OZ. Skin's guard under the sun.
The 5in1 Antiaging + Antispot Red Grape Tinted Sunscreen Face Cream offers complete daily care, combining:
high protection against UVA-UVB,
antiwrinke action,
clinically proven preventive and restoring antispot action,
moisturising action,
naturally-glowing skin in a single step.
Reduced appearance of wrinkles, and age spots is visible withing the first 4 weeks of use*. With a non-oily texture, it provides light coverage, leaving skin shine-free. Skin is radiant, young-looking, with an even tone.
*Clinical trial / Self-evaluation (panel of 32 women)
Antiageing/ Antispot GRAPE STEM CELL ANTIOXIDANT SYSTEM 0 We extract the marcs after they have been dried under the bright Greek sun for 48 hours. We follow a 100% zero-waste process, using natural solvents only. Solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
The Antiaging + Antispot Red Grape Tinted Sunscreen Face Cream Matte is based on a red grape stem cell active; derived from a rare grape cultivar which has red flesh and red juice. A rich source of potent antioxidants, anthocyanins, helping protect skin against photoageing, the main cause of premature ageing. In addition to this active, the formula has been developed with soy extract that helps reduce the appearance of age spots, while offering radiance and even skin tone.
Form, function and elegance, in our language; minimalist and modest, in full harmony with what makes natural beauty distinct. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply evenly onto face and neck, avoiding the eye area, at least 30 minutes before exposure to the sun. Re-apply frequently to maintain protection, especially after perspiring, swimming or towelling. In order to reach the protection level indicated by the sun protection factor, sunscreen products have to be applied in a quantity that is equal to 2 mg/cm² (approx. 1/3 teaspoon for the face and neck).
Warning: Not using the adequate quantity of sunscreen will lower the level of protection significantly. Do not stay too long in the sun, even while using a sunscreen product. Over exposure to the sun is a serious health threat. Wait until the product is fully absorbed, before you get dressed. Sunscreen products may cause stains on clothing. Keep babies and young children out of direct sunlight.
Visible reduction of dark spots + wrinkles within 1 month*
*7 in 10 women who tried KORRES Red Grape Tinted SPF50 / Self-evaluation, 32 panelists between 35-70 years old.
Even skin tone from 1st use*
*8 in 10 of women who tried KORRES Red Grape Tinted SPF50 / Self-evaluation, 32 panelists between 35-70 years old.

tabs.Χρήση:
Απλώστε ομοιόμορφα σε πρόσωπο και λαιμό τουλάχιστον 30 λεπτά πριν την έκθεση στον ήλιο. Επαναλάβετε τη χρήση συχνά, για να διατηρείτε την προστασία, ιδιαίτερα μετά από εφίδρωση, κολύμπι ή σκούπισμα. Για να επιτύχετε την προστασία που αντιστοιχεί στο δείκτη ηλιακής προστασίας πρέπει να χρησιμοποιήσετε ποσότητα 2mg/cm² (περίπου 1/3 κουταλάκι του γλυκού για το πρόσωπο και το λαιμό).
Προειδοποίηση: Η μείωση της ενδεικνυόμενης ποσότητας περιορίζει σημαντικά το επίπεδο προστασίας. Μην εκτίθεστε πολλή ώρα στον ήλιο ακόμα και αν χρησιμοποιείτε αντηλιακό. Η υπερβολική έκθεση στον ήλιο αποτελεί σοβαρή απειλή για την υγεία. Αφήστε χρόνο ώστε το προϊόν να απορροφηθεί πριν έρθει σε επαφή με τα ρούχα. Τα αντηλιακά προϊόντα ενδέχεται να προκαλέσουν λεκέδες στα ρούχα. Τα αντηλιακά προϊόντα ενδέχεται να προκαλέσουν λεκέδες στα ρούχα. Τα βρέφη και τα μικρά παιδιά δεν πρέπει να εκτίθενται καθόλου στο άμεσο ηλιακό φως.
tabs.Σύνθεση:
Απόλυτη προστασία από τον ήλιο και την πρόωρη γήρανση, καθημερινά.
Η Κόκκινο Σταφύλι Αντηλιακή + Antispot + Αντιρυτιδική Κρέμα Προσώπου με χρώμα προσφέρει δράση 5σε1:
προστατεύει από την ηλιακή ακτινοβολία UVA-UVB,
ενυδατώνει,
μειώνει την εμφάνιση ρυτίδων,
προλαμβάνει και μειώνει την εμφάνιση πανάδων που οφείλονται στην ηλιακή ακτινοβολία,
χαρίζει φυσική λάμψη με μία κίνηση.
H μείωση εμφάνισης πανάδων και ρυτίδων είναι ορατή από τις πρώτες 4 εβδομάδες εφαρμογής*. Με μη-λιπαρή, λεπτή υφή προσδίδει ελαφριά κάλυψη, χωρίς να αφήνει λεκέδες και γυαλάδα στο δέρμα. Η επιδερμίδα είναι λαμπερή, με ομοιόμορφο τόνο και νεανική όψη.
*Κλινική δοκιμή αυτο-αξιολόγησης (32 γυναίκες)

details.descriptionEn:
Cleansing Emulsion A total 3-in-1 facial cleansing emulsion that removes face and eye makeup, tones complexion and detoxes the skin from pollutants with Olympus Tea and BioDTox™ antioxidants, while locking in hydrationfor a healthy-looking skin complexion.
Powered by:
Olympus Tea, a deeply enriched antioxidant from the foothills of Mount Olympus.
BioDTox™, a powerful antioxidant blend with Broccoli and aloe leaf polyphenols.
BioDTox™ = trademark of CLARIANT.
Dermatologically + ophthalmologically tested
May contain traces of wheat / nuts
Gently massage into the face, neck and eye area and remove emulsion with cotton pads. Can be rinsed or tissued off.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, HYDROGENATED POLYDECENE, SQUALANE, PROPANEDIOL, DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF EXTRACT, ASCORBYL PALMITATE, BIOFLAVONOIDS, BRASSICA OLERACEA ITALICA (BROCCOLI) EXTRACT, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, CARBOMER, CELLULOSE GUM, CHAMOMILLA RECUTITA (MATRICARIA) FLOWER EXTRACT, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, GLYCERIN, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS (SUNFLOWER) SEED OIL, LACTIC ACID, LECITHIN, MICROCRYSTALLINE CELLULOSE, PANTHENOL, PHENETHYL ALCOHOL, PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) OIL, SIDERITIS SCARDICA FLOWER/LEAF/STEM EXTRACT, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, TOCOPHEROL, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE. May contain traces of wheat / nuts.
388 Used in folk medicine for centuries and known for its antioxidant properties, Olympus Τea is such a unique treasure of Greek nature, growing at the foothills of the mythical Olympus Μountain. A family of local farmers with long-standing tradition in this specific cultivation, part of our fair-trade network, provide us with the organic Olympus Τea blossoms, grown for the first time with sustainable cultivation methods, thus protecting the species endangered wild populations.
150 mL / 5.07 FL.OZ. Olympus Tea is a face cleansing collection with detoxifying antipollution action. A formula that effectively removes impurities, face and eye make-up, and external pollutants, while protecting against environmental stress and toxins. Skin feels deeply detoxed, purified and immediately revived , as skin moisture improves .
BioDTox™ 0 We are the first to introduce the “mythical” Olympus Tea extract to to the global cosmetic ingredient bible (WINCI ). The delicate Olympus Tea blossoms are extracted at the KORRES Extraction Facility through a 100% zero-waste process and the exclusive use of natural solvents, to sustain their antioxidant properties. Solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
KORRES Olympus Tea extract, known for its antioxidant properties, is paired with BioDTox™ -a potent antioxidant blend with broccoli and aloe leaf polyphenols, giving that powerful detoxed, refreshed skin feel.
Minimal design that reflects the freshness and purity of this unique Greek ingredient. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Gently massage into the face, neck and eye area and remove emulsion with cotton pads. Can be rinsed or tissued off.
0 96% Natural Origin Content true

name: Aloe Vera Ενυδατικό Γαλάκτωμα Σώματος
description: Ενυδατικό γαλάκτωμα σώματος με ανάλαφρη υφή και άμεση απορρόφηση, ιδανικό για χρήση μετά την έκθεση στον ήλιο. Ενισχυμένο με εκχύλισμα Αλόης, έλαιο αβοκάντο, καλέντουλα και βιταμίνες. Xαρίζει ευχάριστη αίσθηση δροσιάς, θρέφει και ανακουφίζει το αφυδατωμένο από τον ήλιο δέρμα. Δερματολογικά ελεγμένο Η ΚORRES συνεργάζεται με το Ινστιτούτο Θαλάσσιας Προστασίας Αρχιπέλαγος με στόχο την επαναφύτευση των θαλάσσιων λιβαδιών Ποσειδωνίας στις ελληνικές θάλασσες, συμβάλλοντας στη μείωση του αποτυπώματος άνθρακα και στη βελτίωση της υγείας των θαλάσσιων οικοσυστημάτων.

details.descriptionEn:
After Sun Lightweight moisturising body milk with fast-absorbing texture, ideal for use after sunbathing.
Powered by Aloe Vera extract, avocado oil, calendula and vitamins. Refreshes, nourishes and conditions dehydrated skin after sun exposure.
Dermatologically tested
KORRES works with Archipelagos Institute of Marine Conservation to reforest the underwater forests of the Aegean Sea; these Posidonia oceanica seagrass meadows have an essential role in the healthy longevity of our seas, while also contributing substantially to lowering the overall carbon footprint.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, GLYCERIN, SORBITOL, COCOGLYCERIDES, GLYCERYL STEARATE CITRATE, ISODECYL NEOPENTANOATE, ORYZA SATIVA (RICE) BRAN OIL, ISOHEXADECANE, BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII (SHEA) BUTTER, PERSEA GRATISSIMA (AVOCADO) OIL, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE, PANTHENOL, AMMONIUM ACRYLOYLDIMETHYLTAURATE/VP COPOLYMER, CETYL ALCOHOL, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE POWDER, ALLANTOIN, ARGININE HCL, ASCORBIC ACID, ASCORBYL PALMITATE, BISABOLOL, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, CALENDULA OFFICINALIS FLOWER EXTRACT, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, CHAMOMILLA RECUTITA (MATRICARIA) FLOWER EXTRACT, CITRIC ACID, CUCUMIS SATIVUS (CUCUMBER) FRUIT EXTRACT, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS (SUNFLOWER) SEED OIL, HYDROXYETHYL ACRYLATE/SODIUM ACRYLOYLDIMETHYL TAURATE COPOLYMER, LACTIC ACID, OLEA EUROPAEA (OLIVE) FRUIT OIL, ORNITHINE HCL, PEG-8, PHYTOSTEROLS, POLYSORBATE 60, SILICA, SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS (JOJOBA) SEED OIL, SODIUM STEAROYL GLUTAMATE, SORBITAN ISOSTEARATE, SORBITAN OLEATE, TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE, TOCOPHEROL, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, TYROSINE, XANTHAN GUM, ZINGIBER OFFICINALE (GINGER) ROOT EXTRACT, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE.
423 150 mL / 5.07 FL. OZ. The Aloe Vera After-Sun Body Milk refreshes, nourishes and conditions dehydrated skin after sun exposure.
After Sun All skin types Suitable for Vegans Aloe extract, rich in vitamins C, E, zinc, antioxidant enzymes, provitamin B5 and avocado oil deeply hydrate and relieve from the burning sensation, while chamomile and calendula extracts soften and condition the skin. Biomolecules of natural aminoacids prolong natural suntan.
Form, function and elegance, in our language; minimalist and modest, in full harmony with what makes natural beauty distinct. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply sufficient quantity onto cleansed skin daily or after sun exposure. Repeat 2-3 times on very dehydrated skin.
Nourishment, comfort and sun-dehydrated skin' relief on first application. Excellent refreshing and cooling action.
In vivo self-evaluation test, panel of 32 people, ages 18-50

details.description:
Πλούσια θρεπτική κρέμα ημέρας που απορροφάται χωρίς να αφήνει λιπαρότητα για 24ωρη ενυδάτωση, λάμψη και πρώτες ρυτίδες. Το λάδι Άγριο Τριαντάφυλλο, πολύτιμο ελιξήριο ομορφιάς του φαρμακείου KORRES σε συνδυασμό με καθαρή Vitamin Super C βοηθά στα σημάδια πρόωρης γήρανσης και βελτιώνει τον τόνο της επιδερμίδας χαρίζοντας υγιή, νεανική όψη.
Εμπλουτισμένη με:
Λάδι από Άγριο Τριαντάφυλλο - ένα Πολύτιμο ελιξήριο ομορφιάς του Φαρμακείου KORRES, πλούσιο σε λιπαρά οξέα για μέγιστη ενυδάτωση και θρέψη.
Vitamin Super C - υψηλής απορρόφησης Βιταμίνη C για ομοιόμορφο τόνο και βελτίωση της εμφάνισης λεπτών γραμμών και ρυτίδων.

details.descriptionEn:
Day Cream Dry Skin This high-performance rich facial cream is designed with stabilized vitamin C for a super charged awakened glow while smoothing out fine lines. The rich texture is designed for ultra dry skin and immediately melts into your skin and unlocks time-released hydration all day.
Powered by:
WILD ROSE OIL - A precious heritage ingredient from KORRES Herbal Apothecary, rich in fatty acids, delivers maximum moisture and plumpness to the skin.
VITAMIN SUPER C - Super powered brightening Vitamin C evens skin tone and improves the appearance of fine lines & wrinkles for a superdose of glow.
FINE LINES + RICH HYDRATION
May contain traces of wheat / nuts
Dermatologically tested
Apply to the face and neck, avoiding the eye area.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, GLYCERIN, CETEARYL ALCOHOL, GLYCERYL STEARATE CITRATE, CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE, C13-15 ALKANE, DISTARCH PHOSPHATE, IMPERATA CYLINDRICA ROOT EXTRACT, PROPANEDIOL, SQUALANE, ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER, ALARIA ESCULENTA EXTRACT, ALGIN, AMMONIUM ACRYLOYLDIMETHYLTAURATE/VP COPOLYMER, ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL, ASCORBYL PALMITATE, ASCORBYL TETRAISOPALMITATE, BIOSACCHARIDE GUM-1, BIOTIN, BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII (SHEA) BUTTER, CANDELILLA CERA/EUPHORBIA CERIFERA (CANDELILLA) WAX/CIRE DE CANDELILLA, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, CARBOMER, CITRIC ACID, CRAMBE ABYSSINICA SEED OIL, DISODIUM PHOSPHATE, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, GLYCERYL CAPRYLATE, GLYCERYL POLYACRYLATE, GLYCERYL STEARATE, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS (SUNFLOWER) SEED OIL, HEXYLDECYL STEARATE, HYDROGENATED ETHYLHEXYL OLIVATE, HYDROGENATED OLIVE OIL UNSAPONIFIABLES, HYDROGENATED RAPESEED OIL, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL, HYDROLYZED SODIUM HYALURONATE, LECITHIN, MALTODEXTRIN, OLUS OIL/VEGETABLE OIL/HUILE VÉGÉTALE, PASSIFLORA INCARNATA SEED OIL, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, POTASSIUM PHOSPHATE, PRUNUS ARMENIACA (APRICOT) KERNEL OIL, PULLULAN, ROSA CANINA FRUIT EXTRACT, ROSA CANINA FRUIT OIL*, ROSMARINUS OFFICINALIS (ROSEMARY) EXTRACT, SERINE, SODIUM CITRATE, SODIUM GLUCEPTATE, SODIUM HYALURONATE, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, TERMINALIA FERDINANDIANA FRUIT EXTRACT, TOCOPHEROL, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, TREHALOSE, UREA, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, SALICYLIC ACID, SODIUM BENZOATE, SORBIC ACID, TERPINEOL, TETRAMETHYL ACETYLOCTAHYDRONAPHTHALENES, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE, LACTIC ACID.
*KORRES WILD ROSE OIL
773 Apothecary Wild Rose is our signature ingredient, long-used at the Korres Herbal Apothecary, the source of inspiration for our first ever cosmetic product. Our precious, pure Wild Rose grows in the Balkan Botanic Garden of Kroussia in northern Greece. The Garden hosts many rare and endemic plant species -it is literally a museum of plants. Dedicated to preserving and promoting our homeland’s biodiversity paradise, this is an initiative by the Institute of Plant Breeding and Genetic Resources of the Hellenic Agricultural Organization “DIMITRA”. The Garden's team was the first to sustainably cultivate Wild Rose, researching and adopting optimum cultivation methods to reach maximum yield' quality and quantity.
40 mL / 1.35 FL. OZ. Skin glow-up on first application , and a total skin-transforming effect in 7 days with reduced appearance of dark spots and increased radiance . Powerful formulas harnessing the power of SUPER C™ and KORRES Wild Rose oil. Targeted action on dark spots, pigmentation and uneven skin tone. Textures are soft and velvet applied smoothly on skin, leaving a unique silky sensation, while getting instantly absorbed. The collection is wrapped in a subtle, pure floral fresh -skin- and eco-friendly- scent to enhance the Apothecary Wild Rose skincare experience.
Fine Lines & Rich Hydration Dry - Very Dry Skin VITAMIN SUPER C Suitable for Vegans KORRES Apothecary Wild Rose oil is an enriched natural, virgin oil deriving from the seeds and the pericarp, abundant in beneficial compounds like oleic, linoleic, linolenic fatty acids, sterols, tocopherols and carotenoids. 100kg of fruits yield just 1kg of our Apothecary Wild Rose oil. Produced with the cold-pressing method, this is the purest and most natural oil, preserving all its supreme qualities. The mildest solvent-free oil production technique, ensuring a final product of superior purity, offering just a small quantity of this precious, non-refined oil. We follow a 100% zero-waste extraction process, while solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
Apothecary Wild Rose oil, deriving from the fruit of the plant that contains 9 times the vitamin C content of an orange juice, is a source of powerful antioxidants, rich in Ω3, Ω6, Ω9 fatty acids and vitamin A. It has moisturizing and softening properties. It offers radiance, a unique glow. The Apothecary Wild Rose collection is powered with vitamin SUPER C™; a high absorption stabilized vitamin C, increasing skin’s vitamin C absorption by 1000% for the most advanced brightening and first wrinkles improvement ever experienced. This specific form of vitamin C is a potent skin-lightening and anti-pigmentation factor, as it converts effectively into free vitamin C once absorbed by the skin.
White roses turned red, stained by Aphrodite’s blood when she gets injured for her love. A striking visual of Wild Rose depicted in a balance that reflects the brand’s world of contrasts, the beautiful simplicity of the alluring Greek natural beauty. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable. Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council). The ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth, contributing to an overall ecosystem balance.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply to the face and neck, avoiding the eye area.

details.descriptionEn:
Body Cream Moisturising body cream enriched with extra virgin Olive oil, a natural source of vitamins and antioxidants and toning Olive leaf extract. With lightweight texture, it is easily absorbed, leaving the skin nourished and soft. With honey scent.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE, COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE, SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE, COCO-GLUCOSIDE, GLYCERYL OLEATE, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE POWDER, ARGININE, CASTORYL MALEATE, GLYCERIN, GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE, HYDROLYZED WHEAT GLUTEN, LACTIC ACID, OLEA EUROPAEA (OLIVE) LEAF EXTRACT, POLYQUATERNIUM-7, SODIUM CHLORIDE, SODIUM GLUCONATE, TOCOPHEROL, BENZYL ALCOHOL, IMIDAZOLIDINYL UREA, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE, BENZYL SALICYLATE, HEXYL CINNAMAL, LINALOOL, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE.
338 Crete is the largest and most fertile island of Greece, with an established, century-old tradition in Olive tree cultivation. Our products infused with supreme Olive oil and Olive leaf extract are filled with local traditions, with the passion and know-how of local farmers on the island of Crete. We cooperate with the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara for the supply of Cretan extra virgin Olive oil of the predominant, supreme Koroneiki Olive variety. Founded back in the ‘90s by a small group of dedicated farmers, this is the first cooperative of its kind on the island that for decades has been trying to preserve this tradition, while promoting scientific research in relation to Olive tree organic cultivation methods. In another area of the island, in the small village of Zounaki, Athanasia Papadantonaki is a pioneer herself, being among the first to adopt sustainable, organic Olive tree cultivation technics on the island. She provides us with hand-picked organic Olive leaves -a bi-product of Olive tree cultivation that would else be discarded and that has never been utilized up to this day.
200 mL / 6.76 FL. OZ. Extra virgin Olive oil from world-renowned Cretan groves along with Cretan Olive leaf extract are the signature naturals of our Pure Greek Olive collection, including an extensive product line-up from skincare, showergels, body creams and shampoos to our best-selling 3in1 Nourishing Oil for face, body and hair. Skin feels deeply moisturized, soft, with increased elasticity and improved texture on first application, while hair looks healthy and feels silky shiny. Our Pure Greek Olive line is infused with fresh, gentle scents, reminiscent of Olive groves and picturesque Greek island yards.
Hydration All skin types Suitable for Vegetarian With valleys at the foothills of mountains and very close to the sea, Crete has the ideal combination of microclimate, moisture and temperature conditions for the production of the best extra virgin Olive oil in the world. In the island' groves these slow-growing, organic Olive trees are watered naturally and kept small in size to be better nourished by the sun. Our supreme Cretan Olive Oil is produced at the certified facilities of the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara, using the pure cold-pressing method. The mildest solvent-free oil production technique, ensuring a final product of superior purity, offering a precious quantity of this non-refined, supreme "green gold”, that preserves all its qualities and beneficial substances. Straight from the Zounaki village of Crete the Olive leaves are taken to our Extraction facility, after they have been dried naturally. We follow a 100% zero-waste extraction process, using exclusively natural solvents, while solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
Both Olive oil and leaves -a Greek beauty secret since antiquity- feature antioxidant and softening substances. Nourishing Extra virgin Olive oil is a natural source of vitamins, minerals, amino-acids and antioxidants. It is literally a multi-tasker; it hydrates, nourishing skin deeply, while also locking in moisture, and improving elasticity to maintain youthful skin that is refreshed and softened. A long list of benefits complemented with hair protection action while repairing damage caused by heat and hair dyes. Our Cretan Olive leaf extract delivers toning properties.
Olive green hues and an Olive tree illustration to remind us that the most powerful, yet pure, beauty secrets hide in nature. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable. Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council). The ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth, contributing to an overall ecosystem balance.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
After your shower or bath, apply the product all over your body while doing a light massage. Wait a while until it is absorbed by the skin before getting dressed.
100% of women felt their skin instantly nourished, supple and softer upon application, enjoying an overall healthy-looking skin*.
In vivo self-evaluation test, 32 women, ages 18-55
*Following one month of use

100% των γυναικών αισθάνθηκε το δέρμα άμεσα ενυδατωμένο, απαλό και σφριγηλό με την πρώτη εφαρμογή, απολαμβάνοντας τη συνολικά υγιή όψη του*.
In vivo τεστ αυτο-αξιολόγησης, 32 γυναίκες, ηλικίας 18-55 ετών

tabs.Σύνθεση: Η σειρά KORRES Pure Greek Olive είναι ένας φόρος τιμής στο νησί της Κρήτης και στο ανώτερης ποιότητας Ελληνικό Ελαιόλαδο -ένα δικό μας μυστικό ομορφιάς ήδη από την αρχαιότητα. Περιλαμβάνει προϊόντα περιποίησης προσώπου, αφρόλουτρα, body creams, κρέμες χεριών και σαμπουάν έως το best-selling Θρεπτικό Λάδι 3σε1 για πρόσωπο, σώμα και μαλλιά. Το δέρμα μένει βαθιά ενυδατωμένο, απαλό, ελαστικό από την 1η εφαρμογή, η υφή του βελτιώνεται, ενώ τα μαλλιά είναι λαμπερά, μεταξένια, με υγιή όψη. Προϊόντα που θυμίζουν ακόμα πιο έντονα το τοπικό στοιχείο, καθώς εμπλουτίζονται με αρωματικές νότες φρέσκες, ευγενικές, ελληνικές.

263 Crete is the largest and most fertile island of Greece, with an established, century-old tradition in Olive tree cultivation. Our products infused with supreme Olive oil and Olive leaf extract are filled with local traditions, with the passion and know-how of local farmers on the island of Crete. We cooperate with the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara for the supply of Cretan extra virgin Olive oil of the predominant, supreme Koroneiki Olive variety. Founded back in the ‘90s by a small group of dedicated farmers, this is the first cooperative of its kind on the island that for decades has been trying to preserve this tradition, while promoting scientific research in relation to Olive tree organic cultivation methods. In another area of the island, in the small village of Zounaki, Athanasia Papadantonaki is a pioneer herself, being among the first to adopt sustainable, organic Olive tree cultivation technics on the island. She provides us with hand-picked organic Olive leaves -a bi-product of Olive tree cultivation that would else be discarded and that has never been utilized up to this day.
75 mL / 2.54 FL. OZ. Skin feels deeply moisturized, soft, with increased elasticity and improved texture on first application, while hair looks healthy and feels silky shiny. Our Pure Greek Olive line is infused with fresh, gentle scents, reminiscent of Olive groves and picturesque Greek island yards.

248 Crete is the largest and most fertile island of Greece, with an established, century-old tradition in οlive tree cultivation. 250 mL / 8.45 FL. OZ. 263 Crete is the largest and most fertile island of Greece, with an established, century-old tradition in Olive tree cultivation. Our products infused with supreme Olive oil and Olive leaf extract are filled with local traditions, with the passion and know-how of local farmers on the island of Crete. We cooperate with the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara for the supply of Cretan extra virgin Olive oil of the predominant, supreme Koroneiki Olive variety. Founded back in the ‘90s by a small group of dedicated farmers, this is the first cooperative of its kind on the island that for decades has been trying to preserve this tradition, while promoting scientific research in relation to Olive tree organic cultivation methods. In another area of the island, in the small village of Zounaki, Athanasia Papadantonaki is a pioneer herself, being among the first to adopt sustainable, organic Olive tree cultivation technics on the island. She provides us with hand-picked organic Olive leaves -a bi-product of Olive tree cultivation that would else be discarded and that has never been utilized up to this day.
75 mL / 3.38 FL. OZ. Extra virgin Olive oil from world-renowned Cretan groves along with Cretan Olive leaf extract are the signature naturals of our Pure Greek Olive collection, including an extensive product line-up from skincare, showergels, body creams and shampoos to our best-selling 3in1 Nourishing Oil for face, body and hair. Skin feels deeply moisturized, soft, with increased elasticity and improved texture on first application , while hair looks healthy and feels silky shiny . Our Pure Greek Olive line is infused with fresh, gentle scents, reminiscent of Olive groves and picturesque Greek island yards.
Hydration All skin types 0 Cretan olive groves + leaf With valleys at the foothills of mountains and very close to the sea, Crete has the ideal combination of microclimate, moisture and temperature conditions for the production of the best extra virgin Olive oil in the world. In the island' groves these slow-growing, organic Olive trees are watered naturally and kept small in size to be better nourished by the sun. Our supreme Cretan Olive Oil is produced at the certified facilities of the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara, using the pure cold-pressing method. The mildest solvent-free oil production technique, ensuring a final product of superior purity, offering a precious quantity of this non-refined, supreme "green gold”, that preserves all its qualities and beneficial substances. Straight from the Zounaki village of Crete the Olive leaves are taken to our Extraction facility, after they have been dried naturally. We follow a 100% zero-waste extraction process, using exclusively natural solvents, while solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
Both Olive oil and leaves -a Greek beauty secret since antiquity- feature antioxidant and softening substances. Nourishing extra virgin Olive oil is a natural source of vitamins, minerals, amino-acids and antioxidants. It is literally a multi-tasker; it hydrates, nourishing skin deeply, while also locking in moisture, and improving elasticity to maintain youthful skin that is refreshed and softened. A long list of benefits complemented with hair-protection action while repairing damage caused by heat and hair dyes. Our Cretan Olive leaf extract delivers toning properties.

Τιθασσεύοντας το φριζάρισμα, τα μαλλιά είναι λαμπερά, μεταξένια, με υγιή όψη και μεγαλύτερη αντοχή στο σπάσιμο της τρίχας*.

tabs.Χρήση:
Απλώστε λίγες σταγόνες σε πρόσωπο, σώμα και μαλλιά. Αποφύγετε την περιοχή των ματιών.
ΓΙΑ ΕΝΙΣΧΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΝΥΔΑΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΘΕ ΜΕΡΑ:
Αναμείξτε 1-2 σταγόνες λαδιού με την OLIVE κρέμα προσώπου και απλώστε σε πρόσωπο και λαιμό με ανοδικές κινήσεις.
ΓΙΑ ΕΝΥΔΑΤΩΜΕΝΗ, ΛΑΜΠΕΡΗ ΕΠΙΔΕΡΜΙΔΑ ΣΕ ΟΛΟ ΤΟ ΣΩΜΑ:
Απλώστε μία μικρή ποσότητα λαδιού σε νωπή επιδερμίδα αμέσως μετά το ντους για να «κλειδώσετε» την ενυδάτωση. Επιμείνετε στις ξηρές περιοχές όπως γόνατα, αγκώνες και φτέρνες.
ΓΙΑ ΜΕΤΑΞΕΝΙΑ ΜΑΛΛΙΑ:
Απλώστε 1-2 σταγόνες λαδιού σε νωπές ή στεγνές άκρες μαλλιών για να μειώσετε το φριζάρισμα και να μαλακώσετε τις σπασμένες άκρες, προσθέτοντας λάμψη και απαλότητα στα μαλλιά.
tabs.Σύνθεση: Η σειρά KORRES Pure Greek Olive είναι ένας φόρος τιμής στο νησί της Κρήτης και στο ανώτερης ποιότητας Ελληνικό Ελαιόλαδο -ένα δικό μας μυστικό ομορφιάς ήδη από την αρχαιότητα. Περιλαμβάνει προϊόντα περιποίησης προσώπου, αφρόλουτρα, body creams, κρέμες χεριών και σαμπουάν έως το best-selling Θρεπτικό Λάδι 3σε1 για πρόσωπο, σώμα και μαλλιά. Το δέρμα μένει βαθιά ενυδατωμένο, απαλό, ελαστικό από την 1η εφαρμογή, η υφή του βελτιώνεται, ενώ τα μαλλιά είναι λαμπερά, μεταξένια, με υγιή όψη. Προϊόντα που θυμίζουν ακόμα πιο έντονα το τοπικό στοιχείο, καθώς εμπλουτίζονται με αρωματικές νότες φρέσκες, ευγενικές, ελληνικές.

338 Crete is the largest and most fertile island of Greece, with an established, century-old tradition in Olive tree cultivation. Our products infused with supreme Olive oil and Olive leaf extract are filled with local traditions, with the passion and know-how of local farmers on the island of Crete. We cooperate with the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara for the supply of Cretan extra virgin Olive oil of the predominant, supreme Koroneiki Olive variety. Founded back in the ‘90s by a small group of dedicated farmers, this is the first cooperative of its kind on the island that for decades has been trying to preserve this tradition, while promoting scientific research in relation to Olive tree organic cultivation methods. In another area of the island, in the small village of Zounaki, Athanasia Papadantonaki is a pioneer herself, being among the first to adopt sustainable, organic Olive tree cultivation technics on the island. She provides us with hand-picked organic Olive leaves -a bi-product of Olive tree cultivation that would else be discarded and that has never been utilized up to this day.
200 mL / 6.76 FL. OZ. Extra virgin Olive oil from world-renowned Cretan groves along with Cretan Olive leaf extract are the signature naturals of our Pure Greek Olive collection, including an extensive product line-up from skincare, showergels, body creams and shampoos to our best-selling 3in1 Nourishing Oil for face, body and hair. Skin feels deeply moisturized, soft, with increased elasticity and improved texture on first application , while hair looks healthy and feels silky shiny . Our Pure Greek Olive line is infused with fresh, gentle scents, reminiscent of Olive groves and picturesque Greek island yards.
Hydration All skin types 0 With valleys at the foothills of mountains and very close to the sea, Crete has the ideal combination of microclimate, moisture and temperature conditions for the production of the best extra virgin Olive oil in the world. In the island' groves these slow-growing, organic Olive trees are watered naturally and kept small in size to be better nourished by the sun. Our supreme Cretan Olive Oil is produced at the certified facilities of the Organic Farmers Cooperative of Messara, using the pure cold-pressing method. The mildest solvent-free oil production technique, ensuring a final product of superior purity, offering a precious quantity of this non-refined, supreme "green gold”, that preserves all its qualities and beneficial substances.
Straight from the Zounaki village of Crete the Olive leaves are taken to our Extraction facility, after they have been dried naturally. We follow a 100% zero-waste extraction process, using exclusively natural solvents, while solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer.
Both Olive oil and leaves -a Greek beauty secret since antiquity- feature antioxidant and softening substances. Nourishing extra virgin Olive oil is a natural source of vitamins, minerals, amino-acids and antioxidants. It is literally a multi-tasker; it hydrates, nourishing skin deeply, while also locking in moisture, and improving elasticity to maintain youthful skin that is refreshed and softened. A long list of benefits complemented with hair-protection action while repairing damage caused by heat and hair dyes. Our Cretan Olive leaf extract delivers toning properties.
Olive green hues and an Olive tree illustration to remind us that the most powerful, yet pure, beauty secrets hide in nature.
90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council). The ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest grow
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
After your shower or bath, apply the product all over your body while doing a light massage. Wait a while until it is absorbed by the skin before getting dressed.
100% of women felt their skin instantly nourished, supple and softer upon application, enjoying an overall healthy-looking skin*.

tabs.Χρήση: Απλώστε τη μαλακτική κρέμα σε νωπά μαλλιά μετά το λούσιμο και κάνετε ελαφρύ μασάζ αποφεύγοντας τις ρίζες. Αφήστε να δράσει για 1-2 λεπτά και ξεβγάλετε με άφθονο νερό. Ιδανικά συνδυάστε με το σαμπουάν για ξηρά/ αφυδατωμένα μαλλιά Αμύγδαλο + Λινάρι.
tabs.Σύνθεση:
Σαμπουάν, conditioners, μάσκες και προϊόντα styling βασίζονται σε εξελιγμένες φόρμουλες -χωρίς σιλικόνες. Ενισχύουν τη φυσική άμυνα του τριχωτού και εξασφαλίζουν την υγιή εμφάνιση των μαλλιών, μέσα από κλινικά αποδεδειγμένη δράση: πιο απαλά, λαμπερά μαλλιά με υγιή όψη για 9 στις 10 γυναίκες με ξηρά ή βαμμένα μαλλιά, σε μόλις 14 ημέρες*.
In vivo μελέτη** σε πάνελ γυναικών με αυξημένες απαιτήσεις φροντίδας μαλλιών (λιπαρό τριχωτό και ταλαιπωρημένα, ελαφρά κατεστραμμένα μακριά μαλλιά) κατέγραψε αυξημένη ενυδάτωση του τριχωτού κατά 28% και μείωση του σμήγματος κατά 44% σε τέσσερις εβδομάδες. Η σειρά καλύπτει κάθε πιθανή ανάγκη περιποίησης του τριχωτού της κεφαλής: ενυδάτωση, επανόρθωση, ενδυνάμωση τρίχας, λάμψη, ελαστικότητα, εύκολο χτένισμα, “ασπίδα” από περιβαλλοντικές επιθέσεις και άλλους εξωγενείς παράγοντες, όπως οι τεχνικές διεργασίες.
*Κλινική δοκιμή αυτο-αξιολόγησης (32 γυναίκες με ξηρά μαλλιά) / Αμύγδαλο + Λινάρι Σαμπουάν για ξηρά + αφυδατωμένα μαλλιά / Ηλίανθος + Τσάι του βουνού Μάσκα για βαμμένα μαλλιά **In vivo μελέτη υπό την επίβλεψη εξειδικευμένου δερματολόγου / Χρήση του σαμπουάν KORRES 3 φορές/εβδομάδα για διάστημα 4 εβδομάδων

tabs.Χρήση:
Προετοιμάστε τη βρεφική τροφή, όπως συνίσταται από τον εκάστοτε παραγωγό. Ελέγξτε προσεκτικά τη θηλή πριν από κάθε χρήση. Τραβήξτε τη θηλή προς κάθε κατεύθυνση και αντικαταστήστε την άμεσα στη πρώτη ένδειξη φθοράς. Εάν η θηλή έχει σπασίματα ή σημάδια από δάγκωμα, κολλάει ή έχει αλλαγές στο σχήμα, είναι ένδειξη ότι μπορεί να αποκολληθούν κομμάτια και υπάρχει κίνδυνος κατάποσης και πνιγμού! Μην εκθέτετε τη θηλή απευθείας στον ήλιο ή σε άλλη πηγή θερμότητας και μην την αφήνετε σε αποστειρωτικό διάλυμα για περισσότερο από τον συνιστώμενο χρόνο, γιατί η λειτουργία της ενδέχεται να επηρεαστεί. Μετά από περίπου 2 μήνες χρήσης, αντικαταστήστε την θηλή.
Παρακαλώ διατηρήστε τις οδηγίες του προϊόντος και της σωστής χρήσης. Σε περίπτωση παραπόνου: Διατηρήστε τα στοιχεία του παραγωγού και τον αριθμό του προϊόντος.
Καθαρισμός:
Πριν από την πρώτη χρήση, καθαρίστε και τοποθετήστε τη θηλή σε νερό που βράζει για 5 λεπτά. Πριν από κάθε συνεχόμενη χρήση, καθαρίστε σχολαστικά το προϊόν με τρεχούμενο χλιαρό νερό και απορρυπαντικο για το πλύσιμο των πιάτων και αποστειρώστε το τακτικά. π.χ. βράζοντάς το έως 3 λεπτά. Μην αποστειρώνετε στο φούρνο μικροκυμμάτων.
Για την ασφάλεια και την υγεία του παιδιού σας
ΠΡΟΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ!
Συνεχές και παρατεταμένο πιπίλισμα ροφημάτων θα προκαλέσει τερηδόνα.
Ελέγχετε πάντα τη θερμοκρασία της τροφής πριν το τάισμα.
Πετάξτε το προϊόν με τα πρώτα σημάδια φθοράς ή αδυναμίας.
Φυλάσσετε τα εξαρτήματα που δεν χρησιμοποιούνται μακριά από παιδιά.
Μη συνδέετε το προϊόν με σχοινιά, κορδέλες, κορδόνια ή λυτά μέρη υφάσματος. Το παιδί ενδέχεται να στραγγαλιστεί.
Μη χρησιμοποιείτε τις θηλές ταΐσματος ως πιπίλα.
Το προϊόν αυτό πρέπει να χρησιμοποιείται πάντα με την επίβλεψή ενήλικα.

Plastic Feeding Bottle Feeding Bottle with medium flow silicone teat 3 months+. Ergonomic and wide-neck design make it easy to use and clean. Made of High-Quality Polypropylene (PP).
Super soft teat made of high-quality silicone
Soft and Natural Feeling
Anti-Colic valve
Orthodontic Shape
Suitable for babies and toddlers aged up to 24 months.
3 months+ / PP Bottle / Super-Soft Silicone / Medium Flow
Prepare baby food as recommended by the manufacturer. From the age of 5 months, gradually switch to drinking cups. Check the feeding teat and bottle before each use. Pull the teat in all directions. At the first sign of damage or defects, throw it away immediately. Cracks, bite marks, stickiness or changes in shape can lead to parts becoming detached and swallowed - risk of suffocation!Do not expose the feeding teat to high temperatures and never place it in disinfectant solutions (sterilization solution) for longer than recommended. After about 2 months of use, replace the teat.
218 300 mL 0 For your child's safety and health
WARNING!
Continuous and prolonged sucking of fluids will cause tooth decay.
Always check food temperature before feeding.
Throw away at the first signs of damage or weakness.
Keep components not in use out of the reach of children.
Never attach to cords, ribbons, laces or loose parts of clothing. The child can be strangled.
Never use feeding teats as a soother.
Always use this product with adult supervision.
INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE:
Prepare baby food as recommended by the manufacturer. From the age of five months, gradually switch to drinking cups. Check the feeding teat and bottle before each use. Pull the teat in all directions. At the first sign of damage or defects, throw it away immediately. Cracks, bite marks, stickiness or changes in shape can lead to parts becoming detached and swallowed - risk of suffocation! Do not expose the feeding teat to direct sunlight or a heat source and never place it in disinfectant solutions (sterilization solution) for longer than recommended, as this can damage the teat. After about two months of use, replace the teat for reasons of hygiene and safety. Before each use, watch out for scratches or cracks in the bottle. They may break open which causes a risk of injury from hot bottle contents. Not suitable for heating in the microwave. Due to uneven heating there is a risk of scalding when drinking. Do not feed straight out of the bottle body for feeding and do not use the bottle for storing hot food. Please always check the temperature before feeding. Prolonged contact with liquids containing sugar (e.g. sweetened tea or juices) causes tooth decay.
CLEANING:
Before using the product for the first time, disassemble it, clean it and then put the individual components in boiling water for five minutes. This is how you ensure its hygienic condition. Before each subsequent use, clean the product carefully to ensure its hygienic condition. Thoroughly clean the bottle, teat and accessories under running, warm water with normal household washing-up liquid and disinfect them regularly, e.g. by boiling for up to three minutes. Do not disinfect in a microwave oven.
Please keep the product and usage instructions. In case of a complaint: Keep the manufacturer's address and item number.

tabs.Χρήση:
Για την ασφάλεια και την υγεία του παιδιού σας
ΠΡΟΕΙΔΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ!
Συνεχές και παρατεταμένο πιπίλισμα ροφημάτων θα προκαλέσει τερηδόνα.
Ελέγχετε πάντα τη θερμοκρασία της τροφής πριν το τάισμα.
Πετάξτε το προϊόν με τα πρώτα σημάδια φθοράς ή αδυναμίας.
Φυλάσσετε τα εξαρτήματα που δεν χρησιμοποιούνται μακριά από παιδιά.
Μη συνδέετε το προϊόν με σχοινιά, κορδέλες, κορδόνια ή λυτά μέρη υφάσματος. Το παιδί ενδέχεται να στραγγαλιστεί.
Μη χρησιμοποιείτε τις θηλές ταΐσματος ως πιπίλα.
Το προϊόν αυτό πρέπει να χρησιμοποιείται πάντα με την επίβλεψή ενήλικα.
ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ:
Προετοιμάστε τη βρεφική τροφή, όπως συνιστάται από τον εκάστοτε παραγωγό. Ελέγξτε προσεκτικά τη θηλή πριν από κάθε χρήση. Τραβήξτε τη θηλή προς κάθε κατεύθυνση και αντικαταστήστε την άμεσα στη πρώτη ένδειξη φθοράς. Εάν η θηλή έχει σπασίματα ή σημάδια από δάγκωμα, κολλάει ή έχει αλλαγές στο σχήμα, είναι ένδειξη ότι μπορεί να αποκολληθούν κομμάτια και υπάρχει κίνδυνος κατάποσης και πνιγμού! Μην εκθέτετε τη θηλή απευθείας στον ήλιο ή σε άλλη πηγή θερμότητας και μην την αφήνετε σε αποστειρωτικό διάλυμα για περισσότερο από τον συνιστώμενο χρόνο, γιατί η λειτουργία της ενδέχεται να επηρεαστεί. Μετά από περίπου 2 μήνες χρήσης, αντικαταστήστε την θηλή. Ελέγξτε προσεκτικά το μπουκάλι πριν από κάθε χρήση, για γρατζουνιές ή σπασίματα, που ενδέχεται να δημιουργήσουν ανοίγματα στο μπουκάλι με κίνδυνο τραυματισμού από την υψηλή θερμοκρασία του περιεχομένου του μπουκαλιού. Δεν συνιστάται το ζέσταμα στον φούρνο μικροκυμάτων, καθώς λόγω ανομοιόμορφης θέρμανσης υπάρχει κίνδυνος εγκαύματος κατά την πόση. Μη χρησιμοποιείτε το σώμα του μπουκαλιού για να ταΐσετε απ’ ευθείας το μωρό και μη χρησιμοποιείτε το μπουκάλι για να αποθηκεύετε βρεφική τροφή υψηλής θερμοκρασίας. Ελέγξτε τη θερμοκρασία του γάλακτος πριν ταΐσετε το μωρό. Παρατεταμένη επαφή με ρευστά που περιέχουν ζάχαρη (π.χ. τσάι με ζάχαρη ή χυμοί), ενδέχεται να προκαλέσουν φθορές στα δόντια.
ΚΑΘΑΡΙΣΜΟΣ:
Πριν από την πρώτη χρήση, αποσυναρμολογήστε το μπιμπερό και τοποθετήστε τα τμήματά του σε νερό που βράζει, για 5 λεπτά. Έτσι διασφαλίζεται απόλυτη υγιεινή. Πριν από κάθε συνεχόμενη χρήση, καθαρίστε σχολαστικά το προϊόν για να διασφαλίσετε τις βέλτιστες συνθήκες υγιεινής. Καθαρίστε σχολαστικά το μπουκάλι, την θηλή και τα υπόλοιπα αξεσουάρ με τρεχούμενο χλιαρό νερό και απορρυπαντικό για το πλύσιμο των πιάτων και αποστειρώστε τα τακτικά π.χ. βράζοντας τα για έως 3 λεπτά. Μην αποστειρώνετε στο φούρνο μικροκυμάτων.
Παρακαλώ διατηρήστε τις οδηγίες του προϊόντος και της σωστής χρήσης. Σε περίπτωση παραπόνου: Διατηρήστε τα στοιχεία του παραγωγού και τον αριθμό του προϊόντος.

Before each use, watch out for scratches or cracks in the bottle. Not suitable for heating in the microwave due to risk of scalding when drinking. Do not feed straight out of the bottle body. Do not use the bottle for storing hot food. Check the temperature before feeding. Prolonged contact with liquids containing sugar causes tooth decay.

Before first use, disassemble the product, clean it and then put the individual components in boiling water for 5 minutes. Before each subsequent use, clean the product carefully. Thoroughly clean the bottle, teat and accessories under running, warm water with normal house hold washing-up liquid and disinfect them regularly, e.g. by boiling for up to 3 minutes. Do not disinfect in microwave oven. This is how you ensure its hygienic condition.

Baby Set Premium set with the necessary products for the baby from the first day, with 100% organic cotton + High quality textiles with respect to the baby skin.
Powered by:
ORGANIC COTTON - A rare and precious raw material, only 1% of global cotton cultivation is organic. Its production cycle is really demanding and made to be as environmentally friendly as possible. From the seeds which should not be genetically modified, to the strict selection of the allowed non-synthetic pesticides, to the end process of fabric production via sustainable methods. Soft and breathable by nature, it is considered the best choice for babies.
OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 (CLASS 1) - An international, baby specific standard based on strict tests on the final product and every single component (fabric, dyes, poppers) and ensures protection against skin irritation.
THOUGHTFULL DESIGN - All garments are designed to be easily put on babies. With flat seams and without unnecessary, itchy tags to prevent chafing and provide ultimate baby comfort.

details.descriptionEn:
Baby Shower Gel + Shampoo 500ml Mild cleansing gel especially formulated for the sensitive skin and hair of babies.
Powered by carefully selected natural ingredients and mild surfactans that gently clean hair and body. Coconut and Almond oils keep the skin hydrated and the hair soft and easily combed.
Almond Oil is rich in vitamins and has a moisturizing and emollient effect.
Coconut Oil offers hydration and nourishment and enhances skin elasticity.
Tear - Free Formula
Dermatologically and ophthalmologically tested / Pediatrician tested / Ideal for sensitive skin / For Εxternal Use / Very well tolerated by the eyes* (in case of accidental contact with them)
*Tested with In Vitro EpiOcular™ EIT
Gently apply on wet hair and body. Rinse off. Ideal for daily use and for cleansing the nappy area.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, SODIUM LAURYL GLUCOSE CARBOXYLATE, LAURYL GLUCOSIDE, COCO-BETAINE, GLYCERIN, SODIUM CHLORIDE, SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE, SODIUM METHYL COCOYL TAURATE, SODIUM LAUROYL GLUTAMATE, CAPRYLHYDROXAMIC ACID, CAPRYLYL GLYCOL, CITRIC ACID, COCO-GLUCOSIDE, COCOS NUCIFERA (COCONUT) OIL, GLYCERYL CAPRYLATE, GLYCERYL OLEATE, GLYCERYL UNDECYLENATE, HYDROGENATED PALM GLYCERIDES CITRATE, PANTHENOL, POLYGLYCERYL-4 CAPRATE, PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) OIL, SCLEROTIUM GUM, SODIUM ANISATE, SODIUM CITRATE, SODIUM COCOAMPHOACETATE, SODIUM LEVULINATE, TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE, TOCOPHEROL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SORBIC ACID, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE.
423 500 ml / 16.91 FL. OZ. "Our Baby collection is formulated with pure natural ingredients, selected following rigorous toxicological assessment and purity controls, allowing the development of a minimal formula with a very high percentage of natural content, that is very well tolerated by babies. Final product minimizes the risk of allergic reactions. Developed with carefully selected, well tolerated preservatives for ultimate product safety, and with allergen free fragrance*. Our efficacious baby products can be safely used since birth, following assessment based on strict protocols of a series of in vitro and in vivo studies. The mild tear-free Baby Showergel + Shampoo is powered by mild surfactants that gently clean hair and body, without causing dryness. EpiOcular™ Eye Irritation Test proved it to be very well tolerated by the eyes in case of accidental contact with them. *Fragrance free of substances identified by the SCCS (SCCS/1459/11) and CLP (Classification, Labelling and Packaging) regulation as likely to cause allergic reactions/allergens of concern."
Baby Cleansing Ideal for sensitive skin 0 High purity coconut and almond oils are amongst the safest and thoroughly researched natural ingredients for babies. High purity coconut oil, rich in fatty acids, improves hydration levels of sensitive baby skin, restraining water loss, and helping maintain its healthy look, without the risk of irritations. Equally safe, high purity almond oil, a source of vitamins, minerals and linoleic acid- moisturizes, nourishing and comforting dry skin, leaving it soft.
"The KORRES Baby universe is filled with love and affection, inspired by the verses of our traditional lullabies, part of our childhood memories and of Greek tradition -our ever-lasting source of inspiration. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable. Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council); the ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth and contributing to an overall ecosystem balance. "
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.

tabs.Χρήση: Εφαρμόστε σε βρεγμένο δέρμα και μαλλιά με απαλές κινήσεις. Ξεπλύνετε με καθαρό νερό. Ιδανικό για καθημερινή χρήση και για τον καθαρισμό της μυρογεννητικής περιοχής.
tabs.Σύνθεση: "Τα προϊόντα καθημερινής φροντίδας KORRES για το βρεφικό και νηπιακό δέρμα έχουν αναπτυχθεί με υπεύθυνη και τεκμηριωμένη φροντίδα σε όλα τα στάδια δημιουργίας της σειράς. Είναι βασισμένα σε αγνά φυσικά συστατικά, έχοντας επιτύχει το βέλτιστο συνδυασμό των απολύτως απαραίτητων συστατικών για το βρεφικό και παιδικό δέρμα. Η επιλογή των πρώτων υλών έχει γίνει σε συνέχεια αυστηρής τοξικολογικής αξιολόγησης και ελέγχων καθαρότητας με στόχο το πολύ υψηλό ποσοστό ευεργετικής φυσικότητας και την καλή ανεκτικότητα του προϊόντος από τα βρέφη. Τα τελικά προϊόντα είναι υψηλής ανοχής και ελαχιστοποιούν τον κίνδυνο αλλεργικών αντιδράσεων. Έχουν αναπτυχθεί με προσεκτικά μελετημένα συντηρητικά, επιλεγμένα με κριτήριο την απόλυτη ασφάλεια στη συντήρηση των προϊόντων και την ανεκτικότητα του βρεφικού δέρματος, και με άρωμα χωρίς ερεθιστικούς/αλλεργιογόνους παράγοντες*. Σειρά in vitro και in vivo ελέγχων διασφαλίζουν την ασφάλεια και την αποτελεσματικότητα για χρήση από την πρώτη ημέρα της γέννησης. Το απαλό, tear-free Βρεφικό Αφρόλουτρο + Σαμπουάν είναι εμπλουτισμένο με ήπιους επιφανειοδραστικούς παράγοντες που καθαρίζουν απαλά το σώμα και τα μαλλιά, χωρίς να προκαλούν ξηρότητα. Οφθαλμολογικά ελεγμένο και ελεγμένο με EpiOcular™ Eye Irritation Test, γεγονός που το καθιστά πολύ καλά ανεκτό από τα μάτια σε περίπτωση τυχαίας επαφής. *Το άρωμα δεν περιέχει ουσίες που έχουν αναγνωριστεί ως πιθανά αλλεργιογόνα από τους φορείς SCCS (SCCS/1459/11) και CLP (Classification, Labelling and Packaging)."

details.descriptionEn:
After Sun Cooling After-Sun Gel Face + Body
An ultra-cooling body and face cream-gel that moisturizes and nourishes the skin, offering long lasting freshness and comfort.
Yoghurt, a natural source of lactose, proteins, minerals and vitamins, increases the water content of the top layers of the skin, instantly relieving tight and dry skin. Epilobium Angustifolium and Fennel extracts comfort dehydrated, sun-exposed skin, enhancing its healthy appearance. With real edible yoghurt.
Dermatologically tested / Non-comedogenic
KORRES works with Archipelagos Institute of Marine Conservation to reforest the underwater forests of the Aegean Sea; these Posidonia oceanica seagrass meadows have an essential role in the healthy longevity of our seas, while also contributing substantially to lowering the overall carbon footprint.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, GLYCERIN, YOGURT, HYDROGENATED POLYISOBUTENE, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, SODIUM ACRYLATES COPOLYMER, PANTHENOL, HYDROGENATED POLYDECENE, LAURETH-9, MENTHYL LACTATE, PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) OIL, AMORPHOPHALLUS KONJAC ROOT EXTRACT, CALENDULA OFFICINALIS FLOWER EXTRACT, CERATONIA SILIQUA GUM, CITRIC ACID, EPILOBIUM ANGUSTIFOLIUM FLOWER/LEAF/ STEM EXTRACT, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, FOENICULUM VULGARE (FENNEL) SEED EXTRACT, GLYCERYL POLYACRYLATE, GLYCINE SOJA (SOYBEAN) OIL, HELIANTHUS ANNUUS (SUNFLOWER) SEED OIL, HYDROLYZED JOJOBA ESTERS, LACTIC ACID, PHOSPHOLIPIDS, POLYGLYCERYL-10 STEARATE, TOCOPHEROL, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE, SODIUM METABISULFITE, ALPHA-ISOMETHYL IONONE, AMYL CINNAMAL, BENZYL SALICYLATE, CITRONELLOL, COUMARIN, GERANIOL, HEXYL CINNAMAL, HYDROXYCITRONELLAL, ISOEUGENOL, LIMONENE, LINALOOL, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE.
423 150 mL / 5.07 FL. OZ. We are inspired by Greek nature and tradition; we translate it into science and deliver it back in formulas with specific benefits. In this case, we turned to the tradition of Greek grandmothers slathering yoghurt on their grandchildren to instantly cool sun-dehydrated skin, a memory that takes every Greek back to childhood!
Yoghurt is a living ingredient -it is host to 4,000 living organisms!- and we are the first and sole brand to have succeeded in turning it into a one-of-its-kind superfood for the skin, following years of research and advanced formulation. The brand’s first ever yoghurt-based product is the iconic, best-selling Yoghurt Cooling Gel, introduced back in 2003; a synonym of Greek summer ever since. This ultra-cooling After-Sun Gel for Face + Body moisturizes, offering long-lasting freshness, instantly relieving tight and dry skin. Nourishment, comfort and sun-dehydrated skin' relief are felt on first application, along with an amazing refreshing and cooling sensation*.
*Clinical trial / Self-evaluation (panel of 32 people)
After Sun All skin types 0 Yoghurt Cooling Gel A century-old superfood for the skin, world-renowned Greek yoghurt has double the protein content compared to other types of yoghurt, thanks to its straining process. It has a velvet, thick texture and a distinct aroma. It’s super concentrated in all those beneficial elements that are essential for our skin, offering deep moisturizing, nourishing action and a unique cooling sensation. It just cannot be replicated in the lab. Epilobium angustifolium and fennel extracts comfort dehydrated, sun-exposed skin, enhancing its healthy appearance.
The Aegean white and blue becomes the inspiration for this packaging; a statement of the simplicity and pureness of the alluring Greek natural beauty. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply onto body and face, avoiding the eye area, after sun exposure. Repeat 2-3 times on dehydrated skin. For maximum cooling effect keep refrigerated. For external use only.
Nourishment, comfort and sun-dehydrated skin' relief on first application. Excellent refreshing and cooling action.
In vivo self-evaluation test, panel of 32 people, ages 18-50

Θρέψη, άνεση και ανακούφιση του αφυδατωμένου από τον ήλιο δέρματος, με την πρώτη εφαρμογή. Μοναδική αίσθηση αναζωογόνησης και δροσιάς.

tabs.Σύνθεση: To Γιαούρτι Δροσιστικό After-Sun Gel Προσώπου + Σώματος προσφέρει θρέψη, άνεση και ανακούφιση του αφυδατωμένου από τον ήλιο δέρματος, από την πρώτη εφαρμογή, μαζί με μία μοναδική αίσθηση αναζωογόνησης και δροσιάς*. Υπερτροφή για το δέρμα, το γιαούρτι έχει εκθειαστεί για τις καλλυντικές ιδιότητές του, αλλά μεταφέρει, παράλληλα, και ένα μοναδικό συναισθηματικό φορτίο -είναι κομμάτι της ελληνικής παράδοσης και των παιδικών χρόνων ως το απόλυτο “αντίδοτο” στο αφυδατωμένο από τον ήλιο δέρμα. Είμαστε η πρώτη μάρκα παγκοσμίως, που κατάφερε να μετατρέψει το βρώσιμο γιαούρτι, μία υπερτροφή της φύσης, σε ένα ισχυρό καλλυντικό συστατικό. Το Γιαούρτι είναι ένα “ζωντανό” συστατικό, καθώς αποτελείται από 4.000 μικρο-οργανισμούς! Χρειάστηκαν χρόνια έρευνας και καινοτόμων μεθόδων ανάπτυξης, ώστε να καταλήξουμε με ένα προϊόν σταθερό, που παράλληλα διατηρεί όλες τις ευεργετικές ιδιότητες αυτής της μοναδικής πρώτης ύλης. To εμβληματικό Yoghurt Cooling Gel είναι το πρώτο προϊόν με πραγματικό γιαούρτι που παρουσιάσαμε το 2003. Συνώνυμο του ελληνικού καλοκαιριού, παραμένει διεθνές best-seller έως σήμερα. *Κλινική δοκιμή αυτο-αξιολόγησης (πάνελ 32 ατόμων)

details.descriptionEn:
Anti-Ageing Serum A breakthrough 360⁰ performance concentrate, specifically formulated for women after menopause to combat sagging skin and reduce the appearance of the deepest wrinkles and age spots.
Powered by:
MENO-REVERSE™ TECHNOLOGY - Natural peptide blend derived from artichoke leaves, clinically proven to improve the skin’s volume and reduce the appearance of sagging.
WHITE PINE - KORRES’ proprietary ingredient powerfully improves the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, GLYCERIN, CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE, PROPANEDIOL, BETAINE, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, ARACHIDYL ALCOHOL, ARACHIDYL GLUCOSIDE, AVENA SATIVA (OAT) KERNEL EXTRACT, AVENA STRIGOSA SEED EXTRACT, BEHENYL ALCOHOL, C10-18 TRIGLYCERIDES, CELLULOSE GUM, CITRIC ACID, CYNARA SCOLYMUS (ARTICHOKE) LEAF EXTRACT, DIMETHYL ISOSORBIDE, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, GLYCERYL ACRYLATE/ACRYLIC ACID COPOLYMER, HYDROGENATED RAPESEED OIL, HYDROLYZED SOYBEAN FIBER, LACTIC ACID, LECITHIN, LONICERA CAPRIFOLIUM (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, LONICERA JAPONICA (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, MICROCRYSTALLINE CELLULOSE, PANCRATIUM MARITIMUM EXTRACT, PINUS HELDREICHII BARK EXTRACT*, SESAMUM INDICUM (SESAME) SEED EXTRACT, SILICA, SODIUM CARBOXYMETHYL BETA-GLUCAN, SODIUM HYALURONATE, SODIUM POLYACRYLATE STARCH, TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE, TOCOPHEROL, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, XANTHAN GUM, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, ALPHA-ISOMETHYL IONONE, BENZYL SALICYLATE, CITRONELLOL, COUMARIN, HEXYL CINNAMAL, LINALOOL, ROSE KETONES, TETRAMETHYL ACETYLOCTAHYDRONAPHTHALENES, PARFUM/ FRAGRANCE, SODIUM HYDROXIDE. *KORRES WHITE PINE BARK EXTRACT
1113 At 1.075 years old, Adonis with its Greek Mythology-inspired name, is the oldest known tree in Europe; a symbol of divine beauty and nature, this is the oldest out of a group of pines discovered by an international research team on the highest peaks of Pindus Mountains. This is a White Pine tree. Its exact location remains still a well-kept secret.The spine of Greece, as the Pindus Mountains are often referred to, is a national treasure host to some of the rarest plants of the country. Where Black Pine forests end, the White Pine trees start growing. This perennial tree has an amazing surviving power, conquering Pindus highest tops of up to 2,500m height. Under the guidance of the Directorate of Forests of Grevena, KORRES sources by-products of White Pine timber production, that would else be discarded.
30 mL / 1.01 FL. OZ. Breakthrough formulations that target all signs of mature skin after menopause with eight out of ten women confirming their skin felt just like pre-menopause skin .After menopause lipid levels and the reproductive capacity of cells drop by 30% and 36% respectively, while within the following 5 years, 30% of collagen is simply lost. Skin thins and becomes more sensitive. Deep wrinkles, visible signs of sagging, intense dryness, rough texture, dullness, ageing spots are all signs of post-menopause skin.Our White Pine collection improves skin volume, sagging and age spots; it plumps skin, improving the appearance of deep wrinkles; it comforts dryness. Nine out of ten women confirmed deeply nourished skin on first application, deep wrinkles’ appearance reduction in just 1 month and a plump, radiant skin with improved volume . Intense hydration, firming, increased density and a sense of skin comfort throughout the day were common features of the White Pine skincare experience for all women who tried it .
Post Menopause Mature Skin MENO-REVERSE™ 0 White Pine Pindus SKINCARE Through a 100% zero-waste process, KORRES attains high quality extracts, using exclusively natural solvents. Solid residue is composted to end back into the soil as organic fertilizer. The White Pine extract was used for the first time in a cosmetic formula by KORRES that introduced this powerful Greek antiaging ingredient to the global cosmetic ingredient bible (WINCI ).
The White Pine collection is powered with Meno-Reverse™ technology with targeted action on post-menopause ageing. A breakthrough natural peptide blend derived from artichoke leaves that helps skin return to its pre-menopause look and feel. It restores vital water levels, clinically proven to improveskin’s volume, dryness, rough texture and reduce the appearance of sagging and deep wrinkles.KORRES’ over ten-year quest for the time-defying secret of perennial trees, led to the Pindus Mountains in Greece. This is where we discovered White Pine -yet another potent natural antiageing treasure hidden in the abundant Greek nature. Primary research in cooperation with the Department of Pharmacy and the Department of Biology of the National University of Athens proved that White Pine extract has a strong antioxidant profile and whitening properties, hence targeting multiple antiageing mechanisms related to post-menopause skin. The KORRES White Pine extract deriving from the tree’s bark, a rich source of polyphenols, enhances elasticity, firms, decreases the appearance of deep wrinkles, increases skin’s resilience and minimizes the appearance of age spots.
Simple, minimal packaging with White Pine creatively depicted on one side and with silver tones reminiscent of the majestic silver tree barks standing tall on the highest peaks of Pindus Mountains in Greece. 90% recyclable packaging. Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council); the ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth and contributing to an overall ecosystem balance.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply day and night with tapping motions on a clean face and neck, avoiding the eye area. For better results allow it to be completely absorbed and then follow with your favourite KORRES moisturizer.
8 out of 10 women confirmed their skin felt just like pre-menopause*. 100% of women reported a brighter skin on first application.Improvement of the appearance of deep wrinkles and age spots in just 4 weeks.
In vivo self-evaluation test, 32 women, ages 55-70
*Following two months of use

name: Χρυσός Κρόκος Ελιξήριο Νεότητας Serum
description: Πολύτιμο χρυσό ελιξήριο εμποτισμένο με το τεράστιας δύναμης φρέσκου ζωηρού εκχυλίσματος σαφράν 1 ημέρας από τα μαζεμένα με το χέρι ύπερα κρόκου (ελληνικός κρόκος). Το δυνατό μείγμα από αντιοξειδωτικά του κρόκου, βήτα-γλυκάνες, πεπτίδια και αμινοξέα δυναμώνει το δέρμα, ενισχύει την άμυνα του δέρματος ενάντια στους παράγοντες καθημερινής φθοράς, με άμεση δράση booster και ορατά αποτελέσματα αντιγήρανσης. Αποδεδειγμένα ανασηκώνει και γεμίζει το δέρμα, βελτιώνει τη σφριγηλότητα και την ελαστικότητα, μειώνει την εμφάνιση ρυτίδων, αυξάνει τη λάμψη και τον ομοιόμορφο τόνο του δέρματος και την υφή. Βιώστε μερικές χρυσές σταγόνες κάθε μέρα για αγέραστο, νεανικό, λαμπερό δέρμα. Κρόκος Κοζάνης/ Φρέσκο
longDescription:
Πολύτιμο χρυσό ελιξήριο εμποτισμένο με το τεράστιας δύναμης φρέσκου ζωηρού εκχυλίσματος σαφράν 1 ημέρας από τα μαζεμένα με το χέρι ύπερα κρόκου (ελληνικός κρόκος). Το δυνατό μείγμα από αντιοξειδωτικά του κρόκου, βήτα-γλυκάνες, πεπτίδια και αμινοξέα δυναμώνει το δέρμα, ενισχύει την άμυνα του δέρματος ενάντια στους παράγοντες καθημερινής φθοράς, με άμεση δράση booster και ορατά αποτελέσματα αντιγήρανσης.
Αποδεδειγμένα ανασηκώνει και γεμίζει το δέρμα, βελτιώνει τη σφριγηλότητα και την ελαστικότητα, μειώνει την εμφάνιση ρυτίδων, αυξάνει τη λάμψη και τον ομοιόμορφο τόνο του δέρματος και την υφή. Βιώστε μερικές χρυσές σταγόνες κάθε μέρα για αγέραστο, νεανικό, λαμπερό δέρμα.
Κρόκος Κοζάνης/ Φρέσκο εκχύλισμα της πρώτης ημέρας
Πλούσιο σε κροκίνες – ισχυρά και σπάνια αντιοξειδωτικά που βρίσκονται στα στίγματα του άνθους. Το φρέσκο εκχύλισμα ενσωματώνεται σε φόρμουλα εντός 24 ωρών από τη στιγμή της εκχύλισης, ώστε να διατηρεί το μέγιστο της αντιοξειδωτικής δύναμής του.
Β-γλυκάνες:
Ενυδατώνουν σε βάθος και ενδυναμώνουν τη φυσική άμυνα του δέρματος ενάντια στο οξειδωτικό στρες και λοιπές περιβαλλοντικές επιθέσεις, που προκαλούν σημάδια γήρανσης.
Συσφιγκτική & αντιρυτιδική δράση:
α. Φυσικό εξαπεπτίδιο-11: Προϊόν βιοτεχνολογίας, αποτελεί το 1ο φυσικό πολυπεπτίδιο, που αποδεδειγμένα διπλασιάζει την ελαστικότητα της επιδερμίδας σε 4 εβδομάδες.
β. Σύμπλεγμα αμινοξέων με χαλκό: Βοηθάει στη μείωση της εμφάνισης λεπτών γραμμών και ρυτίδων.
γ. Υαλουρονικό οξύ χαμηλού μοριακού βάρους: Μικρό μόριο που απορροφάται σε βάθος για μέγιστη δράση και τελικό αποτέλεσμα λείας, «γεμάτης» επιδερμίδας.
Μπορεί να περιέχει ίχνη σιταριού / ξηρών καρπών
Δερματολογικά ελεγμένο

1838 Earth’s gold, nature’s most precious plant, the Saffron flower, else known as the Krocus flower. Growing in Kozani, North Greece, and giving its name to the land where it comes from, the Krocus village. Krocus Kozanis is the world’s most premium Saffron quality. Farmed organically by locals who carry out the century-old tradition to this day, Krocus blossoms only once a year, every October, for barely two weeks, creating a purple carpet effect as far as the eye can see. Our partnership with the Cooperative of Saffron Producers of Kozani supports the local economy and hundreds of families from those 20 surrounding villages who depend on income from the annual Saffron harvest.
30 mL / 1.01 FL. OZ. Firmer, smoother, healthy-looking skin in two weeks , with an instant glow . Universal antiageing; the precious Golden Krocus ritual is ideal for all ages, skin types and skin concerns, working to improve the overall appearance of our skin, plumping, brightening, firming, lifting, smoothing-out wrinkles and texture.
Antiageing All skin types Suitable for Vegans Krocus Kozanis It takes 150,000 Saffron flowers for just 1 kilo of the precious Krocus red stigmas. The Golden Krocus formula contains literally day-fresh Greek Saffron extract to maintain its maximum antioxidant potency.
Saffron flower red stigmas, a rich source of superior antioxidant crocins, contribute to an overall fine skin condition. The Golden Krocus formula contains literally one-day fresh Saffron extract to maintain its maximum antioxidant potency. This is boosted with multi-tasking B-glucans for targeted anti-ageing action, addressing every age, skin type and concern. It moisturises deeply, while working to support skin’s natural defense against external factors. It also firms and plumps skin.
The artwork packaging reflects this rare, precious flower. Its qualities, its colors, its beauty. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply to the face and neck, avoiding the eye area. For external use only.

1838 Earth’s gold, nature’s most precious plant, the Saffron flower, else known as the Krocus flower. Growing in Kozani, North Greece, and giving its name to the land where it comes from, the Krocus village. Krocus Kozanis is the world’s most premium Saffron quality. Farmed organically by locals who carry out the century-old tradition to this day, Krocus blossoms only once a year, every October, for barely two weeks, creating a purple carpet effect as far as the eye can see. Our partnership with the Cooperative of Saffron Producers of Kozani supports the local economy and hundreds of families from those 20 surrounding villages who depend on income from the annual Saffron harvest.
30 mL / 1.01 FL. OZ. Firmer, smoother, healthy-looking skin in two weeks , with an instant glow . Universal antiageing; the precious Golden Krocus ritual is ideal for all ages, skin types and skin concerns, working to improve the overall appearance of our skin, plumping, brightening, firming, lifting, smoothing-out wrinkles and texture.

Night Cream Mature Skin An overnight Sleeping Facial that smooths the appearance of wrinkles and replenishes moisture to post-menopausal skin through the night, with Meno-Reverse™ technology and a Retinol Alternative both comforting for sensitive, thinning skin.
Powered by:
MENO-REVERSE™ TECHNOLOGY - Natural peptide blend derived from artichoke leaves, clinically proven to improve the skin’s volume and reduce the appearance of sagging.
WHITE PINE - KORRES’ proprietary ingredient powerfully improves the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
RETINOL ALTERNATIVE - An alternative to retinol that smooths the appearance of wrinkles while bringing forward radiant, younger looking skin while keeping skin feeling comforted.

1073 At 1.075 years old, Adonis with its Greek Mythology-inspired name, is the oldest known tree in Europe; a symbol of divine beauty and nature, this is the oldest out of a group of pines discovered by an international research team on the highest peaks of Pindus Mountains. This is a White Pine tree. Its exact location remains still a well-kept secret.The spine of Greece, as the Pindus Mountains are often referred to, is a national treasure host to some of the rarest plants of the country. Where Black Pine forests end, the White Pine trees start growing. This perennial tree has an amazing surviving power, conquering Pindus highest tops of up to 2,500m height. Under the guidance of the Directorate of Forests of Grevena, KORRES sources by-products of White Pine timber production, that would else be discarded.
40 mL / 1.35 FL. OZ. Breakthrough formulations that target all signs of mature skin after menopause with eight out of ten women confirming their skin felt just like pre-menopause skin .After menopause lipid levels and the reproductive capacity of cells drop by 30% and 36% respectively, while within the following 5 years, 30% of collagen is simply lost. Skin thins and becomes more sensitive. Deep wrinkles, visible signs of sagging, intense dryness, rough texture, dullness, ageing spots are all signs of post-menopause skin.Our White Pine collection improves skin volume, sagging and age spots; it plumps skin, improving the appearance of deep wrinkles; it comforts dryness. Nine out of ten women confirmed deeply nourished skin on first application, deep wrinkles’ appearance reduction in just 1 month and a plump, radiant skin with improved volume . Intense hydration, firming, increased density and a sense of skin comfort throughout the day were common features of the White Pine skincare experience for all women who tried it .
Post Menopause Mature Skin MENO-REVERSE™ 0 White Pine Pindus SKINCARE Through a 100% zero-waste process, KORRES attains high quality extracts, using exclusively natural solvents. Solid residue is composted to end back into the soil as organic fertilizer. The White Pine extract was used for the first time in a cosmetic formula by KORRES that introduced this powerful Greek antiaging ingredient to the global cosmetic ingredient bible (WINCI).
The White Pine collection is powered with Meno-Reverse™ technology with targeted action on post-menopause ageing. A breakthrough natural peptide blend derived from artichoke leaves that helps skin return to its pre-menopause look and feel. It restores vital water levels, clinically proven to improveskin’s volume, dryness, rough texture and reduce the appearance of sagging and deep wrinkles.KORRES’ over ten-year quest for the time-defying secret of perennial trees, led to the Pindus Mountains in Greece. This is where we discovered White Pine -yet another potent natural antiageing treasure hidden in the abundant Greek nature. Primary research in cooperation with the Department of Pharmacy and the Department of Biology of the National University of Athens proved that White Pine extract has a strong antioxidant profile and whitening properties, hence targeting multiple antiageing mechanisms related to post-menopause skin. The KORRES White Pine extract deriving from the tree’s bark, a rich source of polyphenols, enhances elasticity, firms, decreases the appearance of deep wrinkles, increases skin’s resilience and minimizes the appearance of age spots.
Simple, minimal packaging with White Pine creatively depicted on one side and with silver tones reminiscent of the majestic silver tree barks standing tall on the highest peaks of Pindus Mountains in Greece. 90% recyclable packaging. Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council); the ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth and contributing to an overall ecosystem balance.
At KORRES we collect packaging waste and ensure it is transformed and reused. We wish to turn empties into beautiful recycled objects, offering them and us a second chance. Our Recycle Lab is fully operational in Greece, aspiring to expand across the globe.
Apply to the face and neck, avoiding the eye area. Use every night after your favourite KORRES serum.
8 out of 10 women confirmed their skin felt just like pre-menopause, with visible results including reduced appearance of deep wrinkles*. Brighter, nourished, plump skin with superior comfort, overnight.
In vivo self-evaluation test, 32 women, ages 55-70
*Following two months of use
0 93.1% Natural Origin Content WHITE PINE POST MENOPAUSE MOISTURIZERS true

tabs.Οφέλη:
8 στις 10 γυναίκες αισθάνθηκαν το δέρμα τους όπως πριν την εμμηνόπαυση, διαπιστώνοντας, μεταξύ άλλων, ορατή βελτίωση στην εμφάνιση των βαθιών ρυτίδων*. Λάμψη, θρέψη, αίσθηση άνεσης και πιο σφριγηλή επιδερμίδα από το επόμενο πρωί.
In vivo τεστ αυτο-αξιολόγησης, 32 γυναίκες ηλικίας 55-70 ετών
*Σε συνέχεια εφαρμογής του προϊόντος για διάστημα δύο μηνών.
tabs.Χρήση: Aπλώστε σε πρόσωπο και λαιμό, αποφεύγοντας την περιοχή των ματιών. Εφαρμόστε κάθε βράδυ μετά το αγαπημένο σας serum KORRES.
tabs.Σύνθεση: Καινοτόμες φόρμουλες που αντιμετωπίζουν όλα τα σημάδια γήρανσης του ώριμου δέρματος, επαναφέροντας την όψη του στα επίπεδα προ εμμηνόπαυσης, όπως επιβεβαίωσαν οκτώ στις δέκα γυναίκες . Μετά την εμμηνόπαυση καταγράφεται μείωση 30% στα επίπεδα λιπιδίων και 36% στην αναπαραγωγική ικανότητα των κυττάρων, ενώ στα πρώτα πέντε χρόνια που ακολουθούν, χάνεται το 30% του κολλαγόνου. Το δέρμα γίνεται πιο λεπτό και ευαίσθητο. Βαθιές ρυτίδες, ορατή χαλάρωση, έντονη ξηρότητα, τραχιά υφή, θαμπή όψη, έντονες κηλίδες γήρανσης είναι τα σημάδια που αφήνει στο δέρμα. Τα προϊόντα της συλλογής Λευκή Πεύκη βελτιώνουν τον όγκο και την πυκνότητα του ώριμου δέρματος και καταπολεμούν τη χαλάρωση. “Γεμίζουν” τις βαθιές ρυτίδες. Αντιμετωπίζουν την ξηρότητα και βελτιώνουν την εμφάνιση των κηλίδων γήρανσης. Εννέα στις δέκα γυναίκες που τη δοκίμασαν, διαπίστωσαν βαθιά θρέψη του δέρματος αμέσως μετά την εφαρμογή, μείωση βαθιών ρυτίδων σε μόλις 1 μήνα και ένα φωτεινό, γεμάτο πρόσωπο. Η αποτελεσματική ενυδάτωση, η σύσφιγξη, η αυξημένη πυκνότητα και η αίσθηση άνεσης καθ’ όλη τη διάρκεια της ημέρας ήταν ο κοινός παρονομαστής της εμπειρίας εφαρμογής για το 100% των γυναικών, επιβεβαιώνοντας ότι η σειρά Λευκή Πεύκη είναι ιδανική για τις ανάγκες της ώριμης επιδερμίδας.
